params.name: partner
params.description: The partner identification code issued by Dailyhunt at onboarding.

params.name: ts
params.description: Current client timestamp in milliseconds; must be included in the signed parameter set.

items.docs: Returns the languages Dailyhunt's content feeds support, each with an English label, a unicode label and a language code. Fourteen codes are published — en, hi, mr, gu, pa, bn, kn, ta, te, ml, or, ur, bh, ne.
